source: Playrix test assignment and supplied Miro reference screenshots

1.criterion: Background is a solid color, gradient, or simple pattern

2.criterion: Background is simple, with a vertical surface or simple color, gradient, or pattern

3.criterion: Object stands on a realistic surface
Object is placed within a simple dimensional environment; background remains simple

4.criterion: Object is integrated into a realistic surrounding environment
Object remains the central visual subject

reference_style.criterion: Colorful stylized casual-game art, not photographic realism
Readable silhouettes, simplified forms, dimensional shading and bright colors
Consistent visual treatment across the full set

decision_policy.FAIL: Clear violation of an explicit mandatory requirement
decision_policy.REVIEW: Ambiguous or insufficient evidence; do not auto-reject
decision_policy.SUGGESTION: Optional artistic improvement; does not block approval
decision_policy.note: Model opinions alone are not proof of violation. Include requirement ID and visual evidence for each verdict.
